takeaway: Longevity is the tell: Flyover's 3-year runners are identity call-outs (their audience's tribe badge), 1440's wipe-survivors all say 'free,' and Morning Brew is mass-scaling social proof. TPO's equivalent forever-ad would be an identity call-out + social proof hybrid — which is exactly what static_testimonial is. The playbook validation: build its successor, don't abandon the formula.

note_on_creatives: Creative images can't be embedded (Meta Ad Library API restriction) — View ad opens the live rendered ad in the Ads Library.
method_note: Meta does not publish impressions for US commercial ads (API-confirmed: impressions are only public for political and EU-delivered ads). Best available proxy: active duplicate copies per message — advertisers clone winners across placements, so copy count ≈ delivery share. 'New this week' = copies launched in the last 7 days. Ads Library caps results at the newest 50 per page, so counts for 1440 (78 active) and TLDR (112 active) are floors, not totals.
